name: ProofBlock
description: Metrics band that presents headline numbers with captions under an optional title and subtitle, with tight and dark variants.
dense: Metrics proof band: headline metrics with captions under a title/subtitle; tight and dark variants.

usage.description: ProofBlock is the numbers band: a set of headline metrics with captions under an optional title and subtitle, with tight spacing and dark variants. Use it to evidence outcomes on case-study or marketing pages; metrics are data props so copy stays with the page.
